articles.title: Reynolds recruits former Balfour Beatty chief to nationalised British Steel
articles.summary: The former boss of Balfour Beatty, the infrastructure group, has been recruited by the government to join the board of the publicly owned British Steel. Sky News has learnt that Andrew McNaughton is among a crop of new directors signed off by Jonathan Reynolds, who was reappointed as business secretary by Andy Burnham last week. Alongside Mr McNaughton, the government has hired Jon Bolton, co-chair of the UK Steel Council; Janet Ashdown, who serves on the board of London-listed Victrex; and David Bond, who oversaw Sheffield Forgemasters' transition into public ownership in 2021, as non-executive directors.
